blocks.text: O'zbekchada gap oxiriga qo'shiladigan tasdiq so'rog'i deyarli o'zgarmaydi: «Bugun issiq, **a**?», «Siz Azizning akasisiz, **to'g'rimi**?», «U shifokor, **shunday emasmi**?», «Kecha aytgan edim-**ku**!». Ingliz tilida esa bunday «dumcha» (question tag) har safar gapga moslab yasaladi: gapdagi **yordamchi fe'l** va **ega o'rnidagi olmosh** olinadi, ma'nosi esa **teskari** bo'ladi: ijobiy gap → inkor tag, inkor gap → ijobiy tag. Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 41-dars), yordamchi fe'llar tizimi — 51-darsda.
Ohang: tasdiq kutishmi yoki haqiqiy savolmi?

Yozuvda bir xil ko'rinadigan tag ikki xil ohangda aytiladi. **Pasayuvchi** ohang ↘ — biz javobni bilamiz va faqat rozilik kutamiz (o'zbekcha «**-a?**», «**-ku**»): It's a lovely day, isn't it? ↘ **Ko'tariluvchi** ohang ↗ — haqiqatan ishonchimiz komil emas, tekshiryapmiz (o'zbekcha «**to'g'rimi?**»): The train leaves at six, doesn't it? ↗ Javob esa har doim **faktga** qarab beriladi (→ 49-dars): Bekzod isn't married, is he? — **No**, he isn't (uylanmagan).

items.text: The exam was really hard, **wasn't it**?
The exam starts at nine, **doesn't it**?
You're Aziz's brother, **aren't you**? — Yes, I am.

blocks.text: Inkor gap + ijobiy tag: muloyim iltimos

Biror narsa so'raganda yoki ma'lumot olmoqchi bo'lganda inglizlar ko'pincha **inkor gap + ijobiy tag** ishlatadi: You haven't got a pen, **have you**? You couldn't help me, **could you**? Bu «yo'q desangiz ham mayli» degan muloyim ohang beradi. O'zbekchadagi «**... yo'qmi?**», «**... olmaysizmi?**», «**... bilmaysizmi?**» ga aynan mos keladi.

items.text: You haven't got a pen I could borrow, **have you**?
You couldn't help me with this heavy box, **could you**?
items.translation: Bu og'ir qutini ko'tarishga yordam bera **olmaysizmi**?

items.text: You don't know what time the bank closes, **do you**?

rows: Open the door, **will you / can you / would you**?
Nobody called, **did they**? Nothing happened, **did it**?
You have a car, **don't you**? He used to smoke, **didn't he**?

items.text: I'm invited to the party too, **aren't I**?
items.translation: Meni ham ziyofatga taklif qilishgan, **shunday emasmi**?

blocks.text: Ba'zan ijobiy gapga ijobiy tag qo'shiladi: **So** you're leaving us, **are you**? — Demak, bizni tashlab ketyapsiz, **shundaymi**? Bu yangi eshitilgan narsaga qiziqish, hayrat yoki kinoyani bildiradi; ohangga qarab qo'pol ham eshitilishi mumkin, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'lib ishlating.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: o'zbekcha «a?» kabi hamma joyda **isn't it?** ishlatish — «You're from Tashkent, isn't it?» → **aren't you**?; «Tom is here, isn't Tom?» → isn't **he**? (tagda faqat olmosh); «I'm right, amn't I?» → **aren't I**?; «Nobody came, didn't they?» → **did they**? (nobody — inkor); «Let's go, will we?» → **shall we**?; «You have a car, haven't you?» (asosiy fe'l have) → odatda **don't you**?

Tag yasash uchun uch qadam: 1) gapdagi **yordamchi fe'lni** toping (yo'q bo'lsa — do / does / did); 2) egani **olmosh** bilan almashtiring (Tom → he, this → it, everybody → they); 3) ma'noni **teskari** qiling (gap ijobiy → n't, gap inkor yoki never / nobody bor → n't siz).

rows: Inkor gap + ijobiy tag — muloyim iltimos
You couldn't lend me a pen, **could you**?
I'm → aren't I; Let's → shall we; buyruq → will you
He isn't here, is he? — **No**, he isn't.

examples.title: Positive + negative tag: **isn't it?** / **didn't we?**
examples.description: Ijobiy gapdan keyin inkor tag: gapdagi yordamchi fe'l (yoki do / does / did) + olmosh. O'zbekchada «a?», «shunday emasmi?».

sentences.text: It's a lovely day for a walk by the river, **isn't it**?
sentences.translation: Daryo bo'yida sayr qilish uchun ajoyib kun, **a**?

sentences.text: You work at the bank on Navoi Street, **don't you**?
sentences.translation: Navoiy ko'chasidagi bankda ishlaysiz, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Madina speaks excellent English, **doesn't she**?
sentences.translation: Madina ingliz tilida a'lo gapiradi, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: We met at Bekzod's wedding last year, **didn't we**?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Bekzodning to'yida tanishgan edik, **a**?

sentences.text: The meeting has already started, **hasn't it**? I'm so sorry I'm late.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish boshlanib bo'ldi, **shundaymi**? Kechikkanim uchun uzr.

sentences.text: Tom will be at the conference in Manchester, **won't he**?
sentences.translation: Tom Manchesterdagi konferensiyada bo'ladi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Your parents were living in Fergana then, **weren't they**?
sentences.translation: O'shanda ota-onangiz Farg'onada yashashardi, **a**?

sentences.text: This dress looks a bit too formal for a picnic, **doesn't it**?
sentences.translation: Bu ko'ylak piknik uchun biroz rasmiyroq ko'rinadi, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: You can ride a horse, **can't you**? — Yes, my grandfather taught me in the village.
sentences.translation: Otda yura olasiz, **shunday emasmi**? — Ha, bobom qishloqda o'rgatgan.

sentences.text: Sarah and James got engaged last month, **didn't they**?
sentences.translation: Sara va Jeyms o'tgan oy unashtirildi, **to'g'rimi**?

examples.title: Negative + positive tag: **are you?** / **is it?**
examples.description: Inkor gapdan keyin ijobiy tag. Ko'pincha «shunday deb o'ylayman, lekin tekshiryapman» ma'nosida.

sentences.text: You aren't from around here, **are you**? — No, I'm from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Siz bu yerlik emassiz, **shundaymi**? — Ha, men buxorolikman.

sentences.text: It isn't going to rain today, **is it**? I didn't bring an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Bugun yomg'ir yog'maydi, **a**? Soyabon olmadim.

sentences.text: Jasur didn't forget about the meeting, **did he**?
sentences.translation: Jasur yig'ilishni unutib qo'ymadi-ku, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: We don't need to bring anything to the party, **do we**?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga hech narsa olib borishimiz shart emas, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: The shops won't be open on Sunday, **will they**?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni do'konlar ochiq bo'lmaydi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Kate hasn't told anyone about her new job yet, **has she**?
sentences.translation: Keyt yangi ishi haqida hali hech kimga aytmagan, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: That wasn't a very good film, **was it**? I nearly fell asleep.
sentences.translation: Film unchalik yaxshi emas edi, **a**? Sal bo'lmasa uxlab qolardim.

sentences.text: You wouldn't want to live in London, **would you**? It's so expensive.
sentences.translation: Londonda yashashni xohlamasdingiz, **to'g'rimi**? U yer juda qimmat.

sentences.text: Oliver can't speak Uzbek, **can he**? — No, only a few words.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'zbekcha gapira olmaydi, **shundaymi**? — Ha, faqat bir-ikki so'z biladi.

sentences.text: Our train doesn't leave until nine, **does it**? So we've got time for coffee.
sentences.translation: Poyezdimiz soat to'qqizgacha jo'namaydi, **to'g'rimi**? Demak, qahvaga vaqtimiz bor.

examples.title: Checking or asking? Tags and answers
examples.description: Tasdiq kutish (↘) yoki tekshirish (↗) va javoblar. Javob faktga qarab: No — salbiy fakt, Yes — ijobiy fakt.

sentences.text: You're coming to dinner tonight, **aren't you**? — Yes, of course. What time?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqatga kelasan, **a**? — Ha, albatta. Soat nechada?

sentences.text: It's freezing today, **isn't it**? — Yes, I can't feel my fingers.
sentences.translation: Bugun qahraton sovuq, **a**? — Ha, barmoqlarimni sezmayapman.

sentences.text: You haven't paid the electricity bill yet, **have you**? — No, sorry, I forgot.
sentences.translation: Elektr uchun hali to'lamadingiz, **shundaymi**? — Ha, kechirasiz, unutibman.

sentences.text: The museum opens at ten, **doesn't it**? — No, at nine, actually.
sentences.translation: Muzey soat o'nda ochiladi, **to'g'rimi**? — Yo'q, aslida to'qqizda.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't fail his exam, **did he**? — Yes, he did, unfortunately.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihondan yiqilmadi-ku, **a**? — Yo'q, afsuski, yiqildi.

sentences.text: We've met before, **haven't we**? — I don't think so. I'd remember your face.
sentences.translation: Oldin uchrashganmiz, **shundaymi**? — Menimcha, yo'q. Yuzingizni eslagan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: That restaurant was amazing, **wasn't it**? — Absolutely, the best plov I've ever had.
sentences.translation: O'sha restoran ajoyib edi, **a**? — Albatta, umrimda yegan eng zo'r palov.

sentences.text: Bekzod isn't married, **is he**? — No, but he's engaged.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uylanmagan, **shundaymi**? — Ha, uylanmagan, lekin unashtirilgan.

sentences.text: The flight was cancelled, **wasn't it**? — Yes, because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Reys bekor qilindi, **to'g'rimi**? — Ha, qor tufayli.

sentences.text: You'll call me when you get to London, **won't you**? — Of course I will, Mum.
sentences.translation: Londonga yetib borganingda menga qo'ng'iroq qilasan, **a**? — Albatta qilaman, oyi.

examples.title: Polite requests: You **couldn't** ..., **could you**?
examples.description: Inkor gap + ijobiy tag — muloyim iltimos yoki ma'lumot so'rash. O'zbekchada «... yo'qmi?», «... olmaysizmi?».

sentences.text: Excuse me, you haven't got a phone charger, **have you**? Mine's completely dead.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizda telefon zaryadlovchisi **yo'qmi**? Meniki butunlay o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: You couldn't lend me twenty pounds until Friday, **could you**?
sentences.translation: Jumagacha yigirma funt qarz berib tura **olmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Sorry to bother you, but you don't know where the nearest cash machine is, **do you**?
sentences.translation: Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, eng yaqin bankomat qayerdaligini **bilmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Listen, you wouldn't mind watering my plants while I'm away, **would you**?
sentences.translation: Qarang, men yo'qligimda gullarimni sug'orib turishga qarshi **emasmisiz**?

sentences.text: I don't suppose you've seen my car keys anywhere, **have you**?
sentences.translation: Mashinam kalitlarini biror joyda **ko'rmadingiz-a**?

sentences.text: Nobody's got a spare umbrella, **have they**? It's pouring outside.
sentences.translation: Hech kimda ortiqcha soyabon **yo'qmi**? Tashqarida jala quyyapti.

sentences.text: You couldn't give me a lift to the station, **could you**?
sentences.translation: Meni vokzalgacha **olib borib qo'ya olmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: There isn't any milk left in the fridge, **is there**?
sentences.translation: Muzlatkichda sut **qolmadimi**?

sentences.text: Jasur, you wouldn't have Madina's phone number, **would you**?
sentences.translation: Jasur, senda Madinaning telefon raqami **yo'qmi**?

sentences.text: Tom, you haven't heard anything about the exam results, **have you**?
sentences.translation: Tom, imtihon natijalari haqida biror narsa **eshitmadingmi**?

examples.title: Imperatives and Let's: **will you?** / **shall we?**
examples.description: Buyruqdan keyin — will you? / can you? / would you? (iltimos), won't you? (taklif); Let's dan keyin — shall we? O'zbekchada «xo'pmi?», «-da», «a?».

sentences.text: Let's have lunch at that new Korean place, **shall we**?
sentences.translation: O'sha yangi koreys restoranida tushlik qilaylik, **a**?

sentences.text: Close the window, **will you**? It's getting cold in here.
sentences.translation: Derazani **yopib qo'ysang-chi**? Bu yer sovuq bo'lib ketyapti.

sentences.text: Don't forget to send me the photos, **will you**?
sentences.translation: Suratlarni yuborishni unutma, **xo'pmi**?

sentences.text: Have another piece of cake, **won't you**? I made it myself.
sentences.translation: Yana bir bo'lak tort **oling-da**? O'zim pishirganman.

sentences.text: Pass me the salt, **would you**? This soup needs a bit more.
sentences.translation: Tuzni **uzatib yuborasizmi**? Bu sho'rvaga biroz ko'proq kerak.

sentences.text: Let's not tell Mum about the broken vase yet, **shall we**?
sentences.translation: Singan guldon haqida oyimga hozircha aytmay turaylik, **a**?

sentences.text: Wait for me outside the cinema, **can you**? I'll be there in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatr oldida meni kutib tur, **xo'pmi**? Besh daqiqada yetib boraman.

sentences.text: Don't tell anyone about my new job, **will you**? It isn't official yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishim haqida hech kimga aytma, **xo'pmi**? Hali rasmiy emas.

sentences.text: Come and stay with us in Samarkand for a few days, **won't you**?
sentences.translation: Bir necha kunga Samarqandga, bizning uyga **kelib keting-da**?

sentences.text: Be careful on the mountain road, **won't you**? It's very icy.
sentences.translation: Tog' yo'lida ehtiyot bo'l, **xo'pmi**? Juda muzlagan.

examples.title: Tricky ones: **aren't I?**, **isn't there?**, **did they?**
examples.description: Maxsus holatlar: I'm → aren't I; there is → isn't there; nobody / nothing / never / hardly → ijobiy tag; that → it; used to → didn't.

sentences.text: I'm next in the queue, **aren't I**?
sentences.translation: Navbatda keyingi menman, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: There's a pharmacy near the station, **isn't there**?
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida dorixona bor, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Nobody called while I was out, **did they**?
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda hech kim qo'ng'iroq qilmadi, **a**?

sentences.text: Nothing serious happened at the meeting, **did it**?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda jiddiy hech narsa bo'lmadi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Everyone has received the invitation, **haven't they**?
sentences.translation: Hamma taklifnomani oldi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod never eats breakfast, **does he**? No wonder he's always hungry by eleven.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hech qachon nonushta qilmaydi, **a**? Soat o'n birga borib doim och qolishi bejiz emas.

sentences.text: That's Emma's new car, **isn't it**? It's really nice.
sentences.translation: Bu Emmaning yangi mashinasi, **shunday emasmi**? Juda chiroyli.

sentences.text: You used to live in Edinburgh, **didn't you**?
sentences.translation: Ilgari Edinburgda yashagansiz, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: There weren't many people at the concert, **were there**?
sentences.translation: Konsertda odam unchalik ko'p emas edi, **a**?

sentences.text: Hardly anyone came to the lecture, **did they**?
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzaga deyarli hech kim kelmadi, **shundaymi**?

examples.title: All tenses: **hasn't she?**, **hadn't you?**, **mustn't we?**
examples.description: Tag har qanday zamon va modal fe'l bilan: has been → hasn't, 'd left → hadn't, should → shouldn't, have (asosiy fe'l) → doesn't.

sentences.text: Kate has been working here for ten years, **hasn't she**?
sentences.translation: Keyt bu yerda o'n yildan beri ishlaydi, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: You'd already left when I phoned, **hadn't you**?
sentences.translation: Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda siz allaqachon chiqib ketgan edingiz, **a**?

sentences.text: We should book the tickets soon, **shouldn't we**?
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni tezroq band qilishimiz kerak, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: They'd prefer to stay in a hotel, **wouldn't they**?
sentences.translation: Ular mehmonxonada qolishni afzal ko'rishadi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Aziz was working in Seoul at that time, **wasn't he**?
sentences.translation: O'sha paytda Aziz Seulda ishlayotgan edi, **a**?

sentences.text: The children have got their passports, **haven't they**?
sentences.translation: Bolalarning pasportlari bor, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Your sister has a house in the country, **doesn't she**?
sentences.translation: Opangizning qishloqda uyi bor, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza could have come with us, **couldn't she**?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ham biz bilan kelishi mumkin edi, **a**?

sentences.text: We must be at the airport two hours before the flight, **mustn't we**?
sentences.translation: Aeroportda reysdan ikki soat oldin bo'lishimiz kerak, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: The new bridge will have been finished by next summer, **won't it**?
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik kelasi yozgacha qurib bitkazilgan bo'ladi, **shundaymi**?

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting someone at a party
examples.description: Ziyofatda ikki tanish suhbati: tasdiq kutuvchi va tekshiruvchi taglar, Let's ..., shall we?, nobody ..., have they?

sentences.text: — Excuse me, you're Madina's cousin, **aren't you**?
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, siz Madinaning amakivachchasisiz, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I am. We met at her wedding last summer, **didn't we**?
sentences.translation: — Ha. O'tgan yozda uning to'yida tanishgan edik, **a**?

sentences.text: — That's right! You were the one who gave the speech, **weren't you**?
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri! Nutq so'zlagan siz edingiz, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: — Guilty! It was terrible, **wasn't it**? I was so nervous.
sentences.translation: — Ha, o'sha men! Juda yomon chiqdi, **a**? Juda hayajonlangan edim.

sentences.text: — Not at all, it was lovely. You live in London now, **don't you**?
sentences.translation: — Aslo, juda yoqimli edi. Hozir Londonda yashaysiz, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I moved there in March. You haven't been there, **have you**?
sentences.translation: — Ha, martda ko'chib o'tdim. Siz u yerda bo'lmagansiz, **a**?

sentences.text: — No, never, but I'd love to visit. It's very expensive, **isn't it**?
sentences.translation: — Ha, hech bo'lmaganman, lekin borishni juda xohlardim. U yer juda qimmat, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: — Very! Listen, you'll let me know if you come, **won't you**?
sentences.translation: — Juda! Qarang, agar kelsangiz, menga xabar berasiz, **xo'pmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. Let's swap numbers, **shall we**?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Raqam almashaylik, **a**?

sentences.text: — Good idea. Oh, there's Madina — nobody has told her we're here, **have they**?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Ana Madina — biz bu yerdaligimizni unga hech kim aytmadi, **shundaymi**?
